intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Haryana by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} public colleges.
IIM Rohtak is the main national institute on this list, alongside NIT Kurukshetra and three state universities. Packages are historical records, and some years in our file go back to {{pkgYearMin}}.
listLead: IIM Rohtak appears first. The first-colleges table may show the five-year Integrated Programme in Management rather than the two-year PGP, so read the programme name before you compare fees or packages.
snapshot: For colleges with a recorded average package, the median is {{pkgMedian}}, in a range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The recorded years run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.

The campuses are in Rohtak, Hisar, Kurukshetra and Faridabad, and CAT is tagged to all {{colleges}} colleges in our records. Use official reports when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Haryana 2026.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Rohtak has a 2023 recorded average of ₹18 LPA and a highest of ₹36 LPA in our files. In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Rohtak is 19, which may differ from an older number on a card.

Guru Jambheshwar University, FDDI Rohtak and J.C. Bose University, YMCA, have recorded 2023 averages of ₹4 LPA or ₹5 LPA. NIT Kurukshetra has no placement year in our first table, so use its official report.

paragraphs: IIM Rohtak's two-year PGP and its five-year IPM are different programmes. Compare them separately from the state university and NIT MBAs.
